items.title: GitLab 未认证CI正则RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者在CI/CD配置中提交特制正则触发校验缺陷，可在GitLab服务器执行任意代码。
items.affected: GitLab(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 未授权提交含特制正则的CI/CD配置并触发流水线
items.impact_scope: 自托管DevOps平台，多暴露公网
items.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

items.title: SAP SDK OAuth2 SSRF泄密
items.summary_zh: 控制tenant_subdomain的攻击者把OAuth2取令牌请求重定向到恶意服务器，窃取客户端凭证。
items.action_zh: 升级SDK修复版本，对tenant_subdomain做白名单校验
items.repro_note: 多租户BTP应用中篡改tenant_subdomain指向自控服务器
items.impact_scope: 多租户BTP应用依赖库，凭据外泄
items.description: The SAP Cloud SDK for Python contains an OAuth2 SSRF vulnerability affecting multi-tenant BTP applications. An attacker who controls the tenant_subdomain parameter can redirect OAuth2 token requests to an attacker-controlled server, causing client credentials to be exfiltrated.

items.title: IBM i HTTP管理端代码注入RCE
items.title_zh: IBM i HTTP管理端代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程认证攻击者利用HTTP Server Administration数据清洗不当，获取敏感信息或执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级至IBM修复版本，限制该管理应用访问面
items.repro_note: 认证后向HTTP Server Administration提交特制请求
items.impact_scope: IBM i主机管理应用，内网核心
items.description: IBM i 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information or execute arbitrary code on the system due to improper data sanitization by the HTTP Server Administration web application.

items.title: SAP ABAP规则处理代码注入RCE
items.title_zh: SAP ABAP规则处理代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 具备特定业务权限的认证攻击者提交特制输入，被规则逻辑当作ABAP代码执行，完全控制系统。
items.action_zh: 升级至SAP修复版本，收紧相关业务权限
items.repro_note: 认证且具业务权限，向规则处理入口提交ABAP代码
items.description: An authenticated attacker with specific business privileges could submit specially crafted input, which is interpreted as executable ABAP code by the rule processing logic. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to execute ABAP arbitrary code into the system, resulting in full compromise of the affected system and high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the system.

items.title: SAP NetWeaver VC越权操作
items.summary_zh: 低权限攻击者利用门户授权检查缺失调用内部操作，按远程连接配置可致远端系统完全失陷。
items.action_zh: 升级至SAP修复版本，收敛门户与远程连接配置
items.repro_note: 低权限账户调用门户内部操作，经预配置远程连接落地
items.impact_scope: SAP门户及后端，企业内网横移
items.description: SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer does not perform sufficient authorization checks in certain portal functionality. An attacker with low privileges could invoke internal operations on a preconfigured remote system. Depending on the remote connection configuration, this could lead to a full compromise of the remote system. This results in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability.

items.title: IBM Maximo AI服务远程代码执行
items.title_zh: IBM Maximo AI服务远程代码执行
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者利用代码生成控制不当，在Maximo AI Service上执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级至IBM修复版本，隔离AI服务访问
items.repro_note: 向AI服务代码生成接口投递特制输入触发执行
items.impact_scope: 企业AI服务组件，内网资产
items.description: IBM Maximo AI Service 9.1.0, and 9.2.0 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code due to improper control of code generation.

items.title: Metasploit API缺失认证
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可访问msf-ws凭据存储相关REST接口，读取或篡改框架内保存的凭证。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本，仅本地监听并限制REST API访问
items.repro_note: 未授权直接访问msf-ws凭据servlet读写接口
items.impact_scope: 渗透测试平台API，凭据集中存放
items.description: The Metasploit Framework Web Service REST API (msf-ws) exposes the credential store through Msf::WebServices::CredentialServlet. Every mutating and read route in this servlet calls warden.authenticate!
